rules.source: Illustrative rule for this demo, not quoted from a published code
rules.explanation: Alcohol advertising must carry the responsible-drinking line.

rules.source: BCAP Advertising Guidance: Use of superimposed text in television advertising
rules.explanation: Every super must stay on screen long enough to read: 0.2 seconds per word, plus 2 seconds to recognise the text (3 seconds for 10 words or more).

rules.source: BCAP Advertising Guidance: Use of superimposed text in television advertising
rules.explanation: Text height is the x-height of lower-case letters in TV lines at 1080, ignoring risers and descenders. 30 lines preferred; 26 only on a single-colour opaque block. Applies to every super.

rules.source: Illustrative rule for this demo, not quoted from a published code
rules.explanation: Superimposed text must sit inside the title-safe area (5% margin).

rules.source: Illustrative rule for this demo, not quoted from a published code
rules.explanation: A disclaimer on the clock slate is not part of the ad. It has to appear after the slate and black, inside the commercial itself.

rules.source: Illustrative rule for this demo, not quoted from a published code
rules.explanation: Superlative or comparative claims can be detected automatically, but whether they are substantiated is a human, evidence-based decision.
